# Thinkfork

> Thinkfork is a macOS app (Apple silicon, macOS 15 or later) that turns AI conversations into a tree on an infinite canvas. Instead of one linear chat, every reply is a card you can branch from, so you can return to any earlier point and ask the part you skipped, and see the whole topic as a map. It runs on your Mac, uses the model provider and API key you choose (for example DeepSeek, OpenRouter, OpenAI, Anthropic or Google), can connect remote MCP services, and stores canvases as local files. It is built on the open-source DeepSeek Harness (DSH) engine and is an independent project, not affiliated with DeepSeek.

## Key facts
- Price: one-time purchase on the Mac App Store (US$9.99; may vary by country). Model usage is billed separately by your provider.
- Platform: macOS on Apple silicon (Intel and Windows not available).
- Privacy: conversations go only to the model provider and MCP services you configure; the project runs no server that receives them; no analytics or cookies on the website.
- Account: none required; you only need an API key from a model provider.
- Get it: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6836753524 (available once the app is approved by Apple)
